wordLists.name: GRE Vocabulary
wordLists.description: Common words from the GRE exam

words.definition: Lasting for a very short time
words.exampleSentence: The beauty of cherry blossoms is ephemeral.
Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society.

words.definition: The occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way
words.exampleSentence: Finding this book was pure serendipity.

words.definition: The use of borrowed capital to increase the potential return of an investment
words.exampleSentence: The company used leverage to finance its expansion.

words.definition: The interaction of elements that when combined produce a total effect greater than the sum of the individual elements
words.exampleSentence: The merger created synergies that benefited both companies.
